brief: The canvas displays the stylized, muscular shape of a horse captured mid-gallop. The figure is rendered in bold, flowing shapes and vibrant colors that suggest speed and powerful momentum. The animation is continuous, showing the horse traversing the scene rhythmically with a powerful, cyclical motion. This kinetic scene is self-contained, requiring no viewer input to maintain its energetic movement and visual spectacle.
statement: This sketch renders a stylized, muscular horse in mid-gallop using simplified geometric shapes and vibrant colors to suggest speed and momentum.
